Overview

As a part of my Suffolk art class, we were instructed to explore the concept of superimposition, or, the concept of layering images or shapes on top of one another, keeping the underlying layers visible. I recently bought a cheap RC Kei truck and quickly came up with this drifting idea using superimposition.

Process / Additional Notes

I took photos of my RC truck in different positions on the ground, layered them in Adobe Photoshop, dropped down the opacity, and then drew each layer from back-to-front. It was a simple formula that was pretty fun and came out with neat results.
